title: GreenLife Nonstick cookware
text:
GreenLife Nonstick cookware. This cookware works as advertised and is very easy to clean.I do still use a little bit of butter or cooking spray for certain foods to add either color or flavor to the dish I am preparing.

After a few months of use I'm seeing stains on the white 'ceramic' coating that will not come out. I have used 'soft sponge' with the polyester abraisive to clean with Bar Keepers friend very gently to avoid scratching and I still cannot get these 'stains' out. Also the blue exterior is showing oxidation markings that also will not come clean. I never cook on high heat, but rather medium to med-low and I'm not happy with this set. No doubt I will be replacing it in a few years. I've lowered my star rating to two from my previous four as a result of these issues.

description: The Soft Grip collection is all about comfort and control. Designed for effortless performance and cleanup, this set features our toxin-free Thermolon nonstick coating, which is free of PFAS, PFOA, lead, and cadmium. GreenLife’s healthy ceramic nonstick is not stuck in the past—that’s why our ceramic nonstick starts with sand and creates 60% less CO2 emissions during the curing phase than traditional coatings. The pans are also crafted with recycled aluminum, because we want your kids’s kids to cook healthy, too. Finished in vibrant colors, this set is outfitted with stay-cool handles to keep your cooking comfortable. Durable glass lids for a good look at any meal in progress without sacrificing heat. For all stovetops, except induction. Oven safe to 350°F. Dishwasher safe. This cookware set includes: 7" and 9.5" frying pans, 1-quart and 2-quart saucepans with lids, 2.5-quart sauté pan with lid, 5-quart stock pot with lid, and 4 multipurpose black nylon cooking utensils.
